en.name: Cabrales
en.summary: Cabrales is a raw-milk blue from the Asturian mountains, ripened in limestone caves, where the blue arrives on its own rather than from an added culture. Treat it like any hard cheese once opened: about 3–4 weeks refrigerated, and 6 months frozen if you are only going to cook with it. There is no published figure for cabrales itself.
en.pantry: This is not a cupboard cheese. It is moist, salty and alive, and left warm it softens, weeps and turns ammoniac within a day. Take out only the piece you are about to serve and let it sit out for half an hour or so to come up to eating temperature, then wrap the rest and put it back. Anything that has been on the board through a long meal should go back cold promptly rather than being left out all evening.
en.fridge: Wrap it in its own foil or in waxed paper and shut it in a closed box — cabrales is aggressive and will perfume everything in the fridge, butter and eggs first. Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. A working limit of 3–4 weeks is reasonable, borrowed from what is published for opened hard cheese rather than measured on this cheese: it goes on ripening in your fridge, darkening, softening and getting saltier. When it turns runny brown at the edges and smells of ammonia rather than of blue, it is finished. Because it is made from raw milk and is a blue, pregnant, elderly and immunocompromised readers are advised to avoid it or to choose a pasteurised blue instead.
en.freezer: Freeze it only for cooking — into a sauce for steak, which is where most of it ends up anyway. Treat 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F) as a reasonable working limit, again borrowed from hard cheese rather than published for cabrales. Wrap it in cooking-sized lumps, double-bagged, because the smell travels through a freezer as readily as through a fridge. It thaws crumbly and weeping and will never go on a cheeseboard again.
en.thawing: Thaw it in the fridge overnight, still wrapped, and use it straight into a hot sauce. Do not thaw it on the counter and do not refreeze it.
spoilage: An ammonia smell that overtakes the blue smell entirely.
Brown, runny, translucent edges creeping into the paste.
Fuzzy grey, pink or black growth on the cut face — the blue-green veining is the cheese, this is not.
A slick, wet rind that smells of rot rather than of cellar.
tips: Buy small pieces often; cabrales is at its best on the day you buy it.
Double-wrap it or it will flavour the butter.
Cut from the wedge rather than crumbling the whole piece in advance.
If you are pregnant or immunocompromised, choose a pasteurised blue, or cook it through.

faq.q: How long does cabrales keep in the fridge?
faq.a: Treat it like an opened hard cheese: about 3–4 weeks at 4 °C or below, wrapped and boxed. No agency publishes a figure for cabrales specifically.
Yes, for cooking. A working limit of about 6 months at −18 °C is reasonable. It thaws crumbly and weeping, so it is no longer a table cheese.

faq.q: Is the blue mould on cabrales safe to eat?
faq.a: The blue-green veining is the cheese and is meant to be there. Fuzzy grey, pink or black growth on the cut face is not, and means the piece goes.
It is a raw-milk blue cheese, and pregnant, elderly and immunocompromised people are advised to avoid both categories. Choose a pasteurised cheese or cook it through.

zh.name: 卡布拉萊斯藍紋乳酪
zh.summary: 卡布拉萊斯是西班牙阿斯圖里亞斯山區的生乳藍紋乳酪，在石灰岩洞裡熟成，藍黴是自然長出來的，不是額外接種的。開封後可以比照硬質乳酪來看：冷藏大約 3～4 週，只打算拿來入菜的話冷凍約 6 個月。目前沒有任何機構針對卡布拉萊斯本身公告數字。
zh.pantry: 這不是可以放櫥櫃的乳酪。它濕潤、鹹、而且還活著，放在室溫下一天就會軟塌、出水並轉成刺鼻的氨味。只切出馬上要吃的那一塊，放室溫回溫半小時左右即可，其餘包好冰回去。整餐擺在起司盤上的部分，吃完就盡快冰回冷藏，不要整晚放著。
zh.fridge: 用原本的錫箔紙或蠟紙包好，再放進密閉盒——卡布拉萊斯的味道很強勢，會把冰箱裡所有東西都染上味道，奶油和蛋首當其衝。溫度保持 4 °C 以下。3～4 週是合理的工作上限，這個數字是借用「已開封硬質乳酪」的公告值，並不是針對這支乳酪量測出來的：它在你的冰箱裡會繼續熟成，顏色變深、質地變軟、鹹味變重。當邊緣開始變成褐色的流體、聞起來是氨味而不是藍黴味，就是到頭了。因為它同時是生乳製品又是藍紋乳酪，孕婦、長者與免疫力低下者被建議避開，或改選巴氏殺菌的藍紋乳酪。
zh.freezer: 只有要入菜時才冷凍——通常是做成配牛排的醬汁，反正大部分也是這樣用掉的。在 −18 °C 下把 6 個月當成合理的工作上限，同樣是借自硬質乳酪，而不是卡布拉萊斯的公告值。切成一次入菜的分量包好、再套一層袋子，因為氣味在冷凍庫裡跑得跟在冷藏一樣快。解凍後會碎散又出水，再也上不了起司盤。
zh.thawing: 連包裝放冷藏隔夜解凍，解凍後直接下熱醬汁。不要放室溫解凍，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 氨味完全蓋過藍黴的香氣。
邊緣出現褐色、半透明的流動狀，並往內部蔓延。
切面長出灰色、粉紅或黑色的絨毛——藍綠色的紋路是乳酪本身，這些不是。
外皮濕滑，聞起來是腐敗味而不是地窖味。
tips: 每次買一小塊、常買；卡布拉萊斯買回來當天最好吃。
一定要包兩層，不然奶油會整塊變味。
從整塊上現切，不要事先全部剝碎。
孕婦或免疫力低下者請選巴氏殺菌的藍紋乳酪，或加熱煮透再吃。

faq.q: 卡布拉萊斯乳酪冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 比照已開封的硬質乳酪：包好裝盒放 4 °C 以下大約 3～4 週。目前沒有機構針對這支乳酪公告數字。

faq.q: 卡布拉萊斯可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，但只適合拿來入菜。−18 °C 下把 6 個月當作合理上限。解凍後碎散出水，不再適合當佐酒乳酪。

faq.q: 藍紋乳酪上的藍黴可以吃嗎？
faq.a: 藍綠色的紋路就是乳酪本身，本來就該在。切面上灰色、粉紅或黑色的絨毛狀黴不是，出現就整塊丟掉。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃卡布拉萊斯嗎？
faq.a: 它是生乳做的藍紋乳酪，這兩類都在建議避開的名單上。請改選巴氏殺菌的乳酪，或加熱煮透再吃。
